data.one_liner: Show beautiful animated dialogs (info, question, warning, success, error) simply in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable AwesomeDialog class to display popups with built-in Rive animations, titles, descriptions, custom buttons, and action callbacks. It supports auto-hide, keyboard awareness, and various entrance animations.
use_when: You need to display alert, success, warning, error, or info dialogs with animations.
You want a simple API to handle confirmation dialogs with custom buttons and callbacks.
avoid_when: You prefer a fully declarative widget-tree approach for dialogs.
You require complex multi-step dialog flows or custom route-based navigation.
strengths: Includes pre-built animated dialog types like info, success, error, warning, and question.
Highly customizable with support for custom bodies, custom buttons, custom headers, and borders.
Built-in keyboard awareness and auto-dismiss/auto-hide features.
weaknesses: Relies on an imperative show method rather than a declarative widget builder.
Dependent on the Rive package for animations which might add footprint.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import awesome_dialog.dart.

alternatives.name: aligned_dialog
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need dialogs positioned relative to a specific target widget rather than centered on the screen.

data.minimal_example:
AwesomeDialog(
            context: context,
            dialogType: DialogType.info,
            animType: AnimType.rightSlide,
            title: 'Dialog Title',
            desc: 'Dialog description here.............',
            btnCancelOnPress: () {},
            btnOkOnPress: () {},
            )..show();
